# MediaPipe Tasks Vision (vendored, offline)

- `vision_bundle.mjs`, `wasm/vision_wasm_internal.{js,wasm}` — `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 1.1.0 (Apache-2.0, Google)
- `pose_landmarker_full.task` — Pose Landmarker (full), float16, from
  https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_full/float16/latest/pose_landmarker_full.task

Used by `static/mocap.js` (webcam motion capture). Everything runs in the browser; no image is uploaded.
